identification: George V full gold sovereign dated 1926, 22ct (.9167), 7.99 g, 7.32 g fine gold. Bright lustrous coin, looks about EF to UNC with light bag marks. In 1926 London struck no sovereigns, so a genuine 1926 has a branch mint mark: SA (Pretoria, common), M or P (common), or S (Sydney, scarcer). Tiny marks to the right of the date at photo resolution are consistent with the catalogue's SA but can't be read.
